description:
## Goal Implement Filament.Hooks.use_state/1. This is the primary hook for local UI state — tracking whether a dropdown is open, what is typed in an input, which tab is active. State is ephemeral: it lives in the fiber's hook_slots and dies if the fiber is unmounted (e.g., on reconnect or conditional unmount). Depends on: C1 fully merged (hook slot infrastructure wired through Renderer, Reconciler, and LiveView). ## Deviation policy Any deviation from this spec requires prior approval. Stop work, run 'bw comment flm-oue.2 "..."' describing the conflict, reopen the ticket, and await guidance. --- ## Where to add the function FILE: lib/filament/hooks.ex (created in C1) Add to the existing Filament.Hooks module: @doc """ Returns the current state value and a setter function. On the first render of this fiber, returns {initial, setter}. On subsequent renders, returns the most recently set value (or initial if never changed). The setter is a closure. Call it from event handlers or effects to trigger a re-render: {count, set_count} = use_state(0) # in an event handler (on_click closure): on_click={fn -> set_count.(count + 1) end} Calling the setter sends a message to the owning LiveView process, which calls Filament.Reconciler.update/4, which re-renders the affected fiber. Rules: call only at the top level of render/1. Do not call inside conditionals. """ @spec use_state(initial :: term()) :: {value :: term(), setter :: (term() -> :ok)} def use_state(initial) do {index, previous, ctx} = use_slot(initial) # previous is the current state value (initial on first render) setter = build_setter(ctx.fiber_id, index, ctx.owner_pid) commit_slot(index, previous) # persist the current value for next render {previous, setter} end defp build_setter(fiber_id, slot_index, owner_pid) when is_pid(owner_pid) do fn new_value -> send(owner_pid, {:filament_set_state, fiber_id, slot_index, new_value}) :ok end end defp build_setter(_fiber_id, _slot_index, nil) do # No owner pid — called outside a LiveView context (e.g., in a test without LiveView). # Return a no-op setter. Tests that need the setter to work must set owner_pid. fn _new_value -> :ok end end --- ## Wire the state-update message in Filament.LiveView FILE: lib/filament/live_view.ex B7 added a handle_info stub for {:filament_update, ...}. Add a new clause ABOVE it for the state-change message: def handle_info({:filament_set_state, fiber_id, slot_index, new_value}, socket) do tree = socket.assigns._filament_tree fiber = Map.fetch!(tree, fiber_id) # Write the new value directly into the fiber's hook_slots. # This bypasses the normal render-pass slot commit, which is correct: # the setter is called OUTSIDE render, so we update slots directly. new_slots = Map.put(fiber.hook_slots, slot_index, new_value) updated_fiber = %{fiber | hook_slots: new_slots} tree = Map.put(tree, fiber_id, updated_fiber) # Re-render the fiber with its current props (state change, not prop change). {new_tree, rendered, pending_effects} = Filament.Reconciler.update(tree, fiber_id, fiber.props, owner_pid: self()) socket = socket |> assign(_filament_tree: new_tree, _filament_rendered: rendered) |> assign(_filament_pending_effects: pending_effects) {:noreply, socket} end Important: this clause must come BEFORE any catch-all handle_info. If B7 has a catch-all, ensure the new clause is placed first. --- ## Test fixtures Create test/support/fixtures/toggle_component.ex: defmodule Filament.Test.Fixtures.ToggleComponent do use Filament.Component defcomponent __MODULE__ do prop :label, :string, required: true def render(%{label: label}) do {open, set_open} = use_state(false) ~F"""
<%= if open do %> open <% end %>
""" end end end --- ## Tests Create test/filament/use_state_test.exs. ### Rung-1 style tests (no LiveView, using with_render_ctx helper from C1) 1. use_state/1 called during render returns {initial, setter} on first render - Simulate render pass with no existing fiber (fiber_tree: %{}) - Call use_state(:closed) - Assert value is :closed, setter is a function 2. use_state/1 on second render returns previously committed value - First render: call use_state(:initial), commit via commit_slot (done internally) - Build fiber with hook_slots: %{0 => :stored_value} - Second render: call use_state(:initial), assert returns :stored_value 3. setter is a no-op function when owner_pid is nil (no LiveView context) - Simulate render without owner_pid - Call setter.(new_value) - Assert returns :ok, no message sent (no crash) 4. Two use_state calls in one render get consecutive slot indices - Simulate render, call use_state(:a) then use_state(:b) - Assert first uses slot 0, second uses slot 1 ### Rung-2 style tests (using Filament.Test.mount/2 from Track F — if available, otherwise defer) If Filament.Test.mount/2 is not yet available (Track F is not merged), write these tests as PENDING with a comment "deferred to Track F" and skip with @tag :pending. Do NOT block C2 on Track F. 5. mount(ToggleComponent, %{label: "menu"}) renders with button visible, panel hidden 6. After mounting, calling the setter directly updates state and re-renders (send {:filament_set_state, "root", 0, true} to the fake owner, assert panel appears) ### Rung-4 style test (integration, requires test endpoint from B7) 7. Mount ToggleComponent in the test LiveView (test/support/test_live_views/). Use Phoenix.LiveViewTest to verify: initial render has no .panel, clicking the button causes .panel to appear. Write this test in test/filament/live_view_integration_test.exs (separate file). ## Acceptance criteria - mix test test/filament/use_state_test.exs passes (all non-pending tests) - Rung-4 test passes in test/filament/live_view_integration_test.exs - mix compile --warnings-as-errors passes - The setter closure captures fiber_id and slot_index at render time (not by reference to mutable state) — verified by test 4 above - Calling a stale setter (after a fiber has been unmounted) does not crash the LiveView. It sends a message to a live process, which should handle the missing fiber gracefully. Add defensive code to the handle_info clause: if fiber_id is not in the tree, log and ignore.
title: C2: Implement use_state/1 — local mutable state with re-render trigger
